description: Sticky bottom section with today and done tabs

edits.intention: idk but make the checkboxes non rounded too / i need a sticky bottom section with two "tabs", one for something like "today" that i can drag or move items to that i want to do today, and one for "done", showing completed items by date (or reuse the same sorting components). this removes the need to show completed items in the main list. The bottom section should also be expandable so it doesnt take automatically up all screen real estate when it fills up.
